description: Newborn reporting form, a text layer with no AcroForm: every blank printed as a run of underscores is a text input named by the caption before it, several to a line ("Mother’s Name:____ DOB:____"), and no underscores stay in the text. The comb of the AHCCCS ID ("A __ __ __ __") is one input. Every caption stays on the page once (#281, F7). A blank's field follows the rest of its own printed line and the lines above its caption: "Type of Delivery" comes before the "Reason for C/Sect" box. Separate rows of the form read one at a time: the NICU Admit row is not cut into columns with the Well/Sick row above it (#281). The check boxes the page draws are inputs with their own words as labels, and each question names its group: "Induction of Labor? Yes [ ] No [ ] Reason for induction" is a Yes / No pair of radios (the "No" box lies inside the printed line "No Reason for induction", which is cut at it), "Type of Delivery:" holds VAG, VBAC and C/SECT, and the Tubal Ligation and NICU Admit questions are Yes / No radios (#281).
